name: Adaptive Sampling with Monotonically Decreasing Density Function
definition: A volume rendering sampling algorithm that uses a monotonically decreasing function to determine sampling density based on distance from the eye, simulating photographic clarity where distant objects are vague (sparse sampling) and close objects are clear (dense sampling).
summary: Adaptive Sampling with Monotonically Decreasing Density Function stabilizes volume rendering by using a specific decreasing function to prevent aliasing artifacts common in simple inverse distance methods.
